verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only importing into the Consensus Library (from Zotero, BibTeX, PDF, or RIS). That is the opposite direction from exporting results. The REST API and MCP server are developer building blocks, not an export feature, and nothing in the pack shows export to documents, spreadsheets, or reference-manager files.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files
